title: Dormant Pocketwire Savings Vaults and Unclaimed Property
content:
**Notice.** A Pocketwire Savings Vault untouched by the customer for the tier's dormancy period of calendar days is reported as dormant under state unclaimed-property law.

## Dormancy period by tier

| | Pocketwire Vault Essential | Pocketwire Vault Select | Pocketwire Vault Preferred | Pocketwire Vault Premier | Pocketwire Vault Reserve | Pocketwire Vault Private |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days without a customer-initiated deposit or withdrawal | 730 | 730 | 730 | 1095 | 1095 | 1095 |

## Points of reading

- **Untouched by the customer** means no deposit or withdrawal initiated by the customer on that vault.
- **Calendar days.** The period is counted in calendar days, not business days.
- **Per vault.** The period runs for each vault on its own activity: a vault is marked dormant on the basis of the deposits and withdrawals the customer initiated on that vault.
- **By tier.** On Pocketwire Vault Essential, Select and Preferred the period is 730 calendar days; on Pocketwire Vault Premier, Reserve and Private it is 1095 calendar days.
